title: Signal Desk — three-backend React bake-off
description: One incident-response React product contract implemented with Snapback, Convex, and Supabase to compare schema, transactional functions, durable realtime, presence, search, derived reads, client integration, local setup, and executable evidence.

backend.stalenessPolicy: artifacts.json is the committed review manifest; projections are ignored content-addressed cache entries resolved and verified by complete inputsHash

reactThreeBackendProduct.build: bun run --cwd demos/signal-desk typecheck && bun run --cwd demos/signal-desk build
reactThreeBackendProduct.toolchain: bun, Node.js, three separately configured backend processes

retainedThreeBackendMatrix.toolchain: clean Git revision, Bun/Node.js, running local Snapback and Convex services, configured Supabase project
